description: This qualification prepares learners to work as skilled operators in pharmaceutical manufacturing environments. The program equips candidates with foundational knowledge of pharmaceutical processes, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), quality assurance systems and workplace safety. Learners develop the ability to support routine production operations, handle materials and equipment, carry out basic sampling and documentation, and assist in microbiological control and utility checks.The curriculum combines structured theoretical instruction with guided practical demonstrations, case studies and simulated activities. Training covers key functional areas including process operations, quality assurance, microbiology, sterilization, utilities, preventive maintenance and continuous improvement. On completion, learners can perform routine tasks independently under supervision, follow standard operating procedures, maintain accurate records and contribute to the consistent and safe manufacture of pharmaceutical products.The qualification is designed for learners who have completed Grade 12 with science and aims to build job readiness for entry-level roles in pharmaceutical production units, formulation plants and related industries within the Life Sciences sector.
